keyFindings.description: Comment handling is one quote-aware pass short. `strip_comment` counts only line start or whitespace before a `#` (:215), so `release-push.sh push-tag "$TAG" ;# keep the toolchain pinned \` followed by `bun install --frozen-lockfile` in envoy_plugin_publish's Push tag step (DEPLOY_KEY in its env) leaves the checker green: the `\` is taken as a real continuation (:262), and the joined `# …` segment is dropped by the `startswith('#')` guard (:272) — while bash starts a comment at a `#` that begins a word after `;`, `|` or `&&` and runs the next line (`printf 'echo a ;# c \\\necho RAN\n' | bash` prints RAN). Stripping per line before the join (:267-269) also resets quote state at every newline: `notes='Release notes:` / `# keep the toolchain pinned' ; bun install` is green at this head and refused at 391d2c2b (both checkers run on the same copy); `echo a\ #; bun install` (escaped space, no comment to bash) and `echo a\` / `#;bun install` (the `#` glued to `a`) are regressions the same way. Fix: one pass over the whole run with quote state carried across newlines; `#` a comment only at word start (run start, after unquoted whitespace or newline, after an unquoted `;`, `&`, `|`, `(`, `)`, `<`, `>` or backtick — not `{`, because of `${#x}`); escaped whitespace is not whitespace; a comment runs to the real newline; `\`+newline joins outside single quotes when the backslash run is odd. The guard at :272 then goes. Fixtures for `;#`, the multi-line-quote `#`, the escaped-space `#`, the glued `#`.

`(?<!\\)\\\n` joins one or two backslashes correctly but refuses to join an odd run of three or more, which bash continues: `printf 'x' \\\` then `bun install` is flagged `runs 'bun'` on a legal body — a false CI failure no real workflow reaches; join when the run before the newline is odd.
`only_bump` says `.version set to v$version` where the value written is the bare version and the clause before it says `.version = 1.0.1`; drop the `v` or say 'the released version'.
